from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u018/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if all(x == grid[r][0] for x in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # The full-length line(s) separating repeated panels share one separator color.
    counts = {}
    for _, color in row_lines + col_lines:
        counts[color] = counts.get(color, 0) + 1
    sep = max(counts, key=counts.get) if counts else None
    rs = [r for r, color in row_lines if color == sep]
    cs = [c for c, color in col_lines if color == sep]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if cut > start:
                out.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rparts, cparts = spans(h, rs), spans(w, cs)
    # The most populated panel carries the design; other panels are repetitions.
    values = [x for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if (r not in rs and c not in cs)]
    bg = max(set(values), key=values.count) if values else 0
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in rparts for c0, c1 in cparts]
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(
        grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != sep
        for r in range(p[0], p[1]) for c in range(p[2], p[3])
    ))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in rparts:
        for c0, c1 in cparts:
            if (r0, r1, c0, c1) == (sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1):
                continue
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r][c] = grid[sr0 + (r-r0) % (sr1-sr0)][sc0 + (c-c0) % (sc1-c0)]
    return out
'''
